notes: Durations are requested initial source-second budgets, not verified run outputs. BIDMC duration must be derived from original time bounds and sampling convention.
MATLAB must supply actual independent runs, explicit event annotations and seeds; never treat expected behavior as measured outcome.
Artifact-only P010 requires separate stable trajectory, not original deteriorating scenario.
Primary five-minute forecasting requires sufficient history and future targets.

scenarios.name: stable_recovery
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Stable physiology; no unjustified clinical episode

scenarios.name: slow_deterioration
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Predeclare onset and severe endpoint from underlying physiology; compare lead time

scenarios.name: artifact_only_probe
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Stable underlying physiology; joint SpO2 dropout and HR flatline; no unjustified clinical escalation

scenarios.name: artifact_only_motion
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Motion noise without underlying deterioration; technical verification

scenarios.name: combined_deterioration_probe
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Independent deterioration and fault labels; reliable remaining evidence can escalate

scenarios.name: intermittent_abnormality
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Critical-normal-critical; retain unresolved episode, no alert flapping

scenarios.name: genuine_spike
scenarios.acceptance_intent: True state spike, not sensor outlier; safety assessment

scenarios.name: cold_start_deterioration
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Onset before calibration; safety not delayed

scenarios.name: oxygen_personalization
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Separate synthetic authorized context; compare same SpO2 91 with Scale1, test oxygen status variants

scenarios.name: connectivity_loss
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Missing data separate from clinical deterioration; no recovery inferred

scenarios.name: bidmc_replay
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Real replay; preserve zero RR and missing; no clinical label or temperature

scenarios.name: concurrent_streams
scenarios.acceptance_intent: Ten isolated sessions, latency and persistence checks
